public_facts.title: Affiliate program private pilot and application status
public_facts.summary: Wake'n'Bake Lounge is proving a five-person private Affiliate pilot. Public applications are closed. A valid private invitation may allow a person to apply, but application and invitation do not equal approval.

public_facts.title: Affiliate eligibility and approval requirements
public_facts.summary: Private-pilot candidates are reviewed individually. No minimum follower count creates an entitlement. Identity, channels, fit, compliance commitments, and owner review are required before approval.

public_facts.title: Affiliate eligible offers and commission categories
public_facts.summary: Only current CCSS-approved Affiliate-eligible offers may be promoted. Governed commission classes include Wellness Physical 30%, Botanical Collection 25%, Infused Basics 25%, Legends Membership 10%, full courses 15%, consultations 30%, and Wellness subscriptions at 30% for qualifying payments 1-3 then 5% for qualifying payments 4 and later. Excluded, paused, rate-required, attributable-only, and unknown offers earn no commission unless separately governed.

public_facts.title: Affiliate subscription, reward, hold, and payout basics
public_facts.summary: Recurring commission applies only to governed qualifying subscription payment sequences. Cancellation produces no new commission. Commissions may be held for maturity, refund, dispute, risk, tax, payout-profile, or compliance review. No bonus or reward exists unless explicitly approved in governed program terms. Payout preparation requires payable commissions, the governed threshold, verified requirements, and human owner or financial authorization; Budly cannot authorize or move money.

public_facts.title: Budly Affiliate help and prohibitions
public_facts.summary: Budly may explain governed program facts, eligible offers, disclosure guidance, links, QR references, product education, preferences, and compliant campaign ideas. Budly may not approve or suspend an Affiliate, change rates, invent eligibility, rewrite attribution, erase financial history, authorize payouts, or expose another Affiliate's private information.
